policy: Current identity metadata research only. User-approved provisional secondary cap policy is not overridden by these scope limitations. This artifact does not independently audit cap values, certify admissions, or require exact primary cap replication. Exact historical share-count replication is a disclosed limitation, NOT an additional admission gate. Security-label confirmation is distinguished from full class-inventory evidence.

sec_current.scope: Current issuer-name/CIK/ticker/exchange tuples actually observed through web open/find. No security-class description or historical Oct9 snapshot.

xom_reorganization.scope: Explanatory note and Note1: July1 2026 reorganization; EMC exchanged one common share for one EMHC common share, $0.001 par; successor remained NYSE XOM. Group business/assets/liabilities/reporting basis unchanged.

ppli_rename.scope: Issuer confirms IAC legal rename and Nasdaq common-stock ticker PPLI effective June4 2026; unchanged CUSIP.

tday_rename.scope: Issuer announced Gannett rename and NYSE common-stock ticker TDAY effective November18 2025.

wmt_transfer.scope: Issuer confirms completed Nasdaq transfer of common stock and bonds.

senea_classes.scope: Cover lists common ClassA SENEA and common ClassB SENEB, both Nasdaq Global Select Market, $0.25 par.

vlgea_classes.scope: Cover identifies VLGEA as Nasdaq ClassA common stock; outstanding ClassA and ClassB shares. Older dated evidence, not Oct9 2026 share counts.

pltr_classes.scope: Proxy confirms outstanding common ClassA, ClassB and ClassF; B convertible one-for-one to A. No Oct9 cap-method verification.
